title: Emergency shelters.
officialText:
Where provided in buildings that are designated as emergency shelters, variable message signs
conveying emergency-related information shall comply with Section 1110.4.
Exception: Where equivalent information is provided in an audible manner, VMS signs are not required to comply with ICC
A117.1.
